reason: Maybe I'd let my child try the free version for ten minutes a day, because no ads and offline sounds safe. But I don't see what PRO adds over the free part, and I'm not paying for more time on the phone when we already have an English tutor.
objection: I don't want my child glued to the phone. An app that wants a monthly subscription has every reason to keep him on the screen longer, and I can't tell if he's actually learning or just tapping a cartoon.
would_change_my_mind: A clear list of what PRO gives over the free app, plus a daily time limit I control, and seeing in the parent area that he really learned letters after a couple of weeks on the free version.
